articles.title: Crypto exchange Coinsbuy loses $8 million in coordinated two-blockchain attack
articles.snippet: Onchain forensics tie a single actor to an $8 million coordinated drain across TRON and Ethereum, with most funds routed through FixedFloat and the attack vector still unknown.

articles.title: Ex-US defense secretary calls CLARITY Act a ‘national security bill’
articles.snippet: Former US Defense Secretary Mark Esper says the CLARITY Act is not merely a financial services bill, its a national security one.

articles.title: BIP-110 Bitcoin branch stalls after two blocks as gap widens
articles.snippet: The enforcing fork remains stuck at Bitcoin’s full mining difficulty as mandatory signaling proceeds with little hashpower support.

articles.title: Domestic stablecoins could boost demand for dollar-backed tokens: IMF
articles.snippet: IMF First Deputy Managing Director Dan Katz says users may favor digital dollars for their liquidity, network effects and cross-border acceptance.

articles.title: Brazil's $319B Crypto Market Faces October Licensing Deadline: CertiK
articles.snippet: A new report maps Brazil's push to bring its vast crypto market under formal supervision by October 30.
